result:
A logged model's status message now survives conversion to its serialized (protobuf) form and back. The new tests pass.

**The fix:** in `mlflow/entities/logged_model.py`, `LoggedModel.to_proto` built the model info without the status message, even though `from_proto` already read it back. I added `status_message=self.status_message` next to the status field. If a model has no status message, the field is left unset, as before. Nothing else in the conversion changed.

**Tests:** there was no test file for this entity, so I added `tests/entities/test_logged_model.py` with two tests:
- A model marked as failed with "Upload failed" keeps that message after the round trip. Its status, tags and params also come back unchanged.
- A model without a status message leaves the field unset. When read back, its status message is an empty string, which is the existing behaviour.

+from mlflow.entities import LoggedModel, LoggedModelStatus
+
+
+def test_logged_model_proto_round_trip_preserves_status_message():
+    model = LoggedModel(
+        experiment_id="1",
+        model_id="m-123",
+        name="model",
+        artifact_location="file:///tmp/artifacts",
+        creation_timestamp=1,
+        last_updated_timestamp=2,
+        status=LoggedModelStatus.FAILED,
+        status_message="Upload failed",
+        tags={"tag": "value"},
+        params={"param": "value"},
+    )
+
+    proto = model.to_proto()
+    assert proto.info.status_message == "Upload failed"
+
+    restored = LoggedModel.from_proto(proto)
+    assert restored.status == LoggedModelStatus.FAILED
+    assert restored.status_message == "Upload failed"
+    assert restored.tags == {"tag": "value"}
+    assert restored.params == {"param": "value"}
+
+
+def test_logged_model_to_proto_without_status_message():
+    model = LoggedModel(
+        experiment_id="1",
+        model_id="m-123",
+        name="model",
+        artifact_location="file:///tmp/artifacts",
+        creation_timestamp=1,
+        last_updated_timestamp=2,
+    )
+
+    proto = model.to_proto()
+    assert not proto.info.HasField("status_message")
+    assert LoggedModel.from_proto(proto).status_message == ""
